text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary rollout v2026.03.15-quota-limiter -> prod (canary: 25%)
Maya Patel: seeing a huge spike in 429s from the canary, can confirm dashboards show throttling up 8x :rotating_light:
Maya Patel: looks like both internal services + customer requests affected, sample logs here: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc/rl?from=now-15m
Incident Bot: Paging oncall (priority: P1) — page sent to @Sam Chen
Sam Chen: oncall ack, joining
Sam Chen: canary ui shows quota enforcement rate up, traffic looks normal, errors are from rl-service (quota-check)
Maya Patel: quick diff of the rollout: the new release included a refactor to rl-service token accounting + config for exemptions
Anya Kuznetsova: Confirmed we have missing exemptions for internal-api keys — calls from internal infra are getting counted
Sam Chen: pause the rollout, flip killswitch for rl-service (feature flag: rl.enforce.strict = false)
Sam Chen: @deploy-bot pause canary v2026.03.15
deploy-bot: Canary paused by request of Sam Chen — 25% remains active for analysis
Sam Chen: rolling back delta to previous version on canary group
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: rolling canary back to v2026.03.14
Maya Patel: logs show token accounting double-counting header X-Client-Token when present plus fallback id header
Maya Patel: sample problematic snippet:
```
// buggy change in v2026.03.15
countKey := req.Header.Get("X-Client-Token")
if countKey == "" {
  countKey = req.Header.Get("X-Auth-Id")
}
// old behavior used only X-Client-Token; new code increments both keys in some paths
quotaMap.Inc(countKey)
quotaMap.Inc(req.Context().Value("session_id").(string)) // session id may equal token -> double count
```
Leo Martinez: that looks like the root cause — session_id sometimes mirrors token, double increments
Anya Kuznetsova: also saw config override removed: `exemptions: ["internal-*", "platform-*"]` missing in new config bundle
Sam Chen: mitigation plan:
- rollback canary to v2026.03.14 (in progress)
- re-enable exemptions via temp feature flag (rl.exemptions.force_include_internal = true)
- run targeted backfill to credit internal calls
- coordinate customer communications
Sam Chen: @Customer Ops are there any known customer-impact calls? how many customers affected?
Customer Ops: preliminary: ~12 enterprise customers saw elevated 429s, highest impact on realtime streaming routes (embeddings calls)
Ops Bot: Incident created INC-2026-278 — tagging eng-sre and cust-success
Maya Patel: rolling back confirmed: canary now at v2026.03.14, 429s dropping back to baseline :white_check_mark:
Sam Chen: great — promote rollback to remaining canaries (gradual) and hold full rollout
deploy-bot: Rollback promoted to 100% canary groups (safe rollout paused)
Sam Chen: notify sales/AE owners for impacted customers, preparing template
Customer Ops: sending initial outbound to AEs now, will CC incident channel
Anya Kuznetsova: captured the exact config diff in INC-2026-278, pushing a hotfix branch to fix token accounting and reinstate exemptions
Maya Patel: quick testing of hotfix in staging shows no double count and exemptions preserved
Sam Chen: handoff: I'm staying on to run the remediation for 30 more mins, then handing oncall to Leo Martinez for the postmortem and follow-ups
Leo Martinez: oncall ack, I'll take post-incident lead. next steps:
- ship hotfix with test coverage for exemption parsing and token accounting
- add canary check that validates exemption lists and internal traffic low latency
- add telemetry alert for sudden internal-exempt hits
Sam Chen: thanks everyone — tags: :eyes: action items on INC-2026-278, assign to Anya/Leo. Updating incident status to mitigated while we validate
Incident Bot: Incident status -> MITIGATED, responders: Sam Chen, Maya Patel, Anya Kuznetsova, Leo Martinez
Leo Martinez: I'll schedule a postmortem tomorrow 11:00am PT and loop in product and customer success
Maya Patel: note for postmortem: add a runbook step to test exemption bundle during canary deploys
Customer Ops: will follow up with impacted customers after hotfix verification
Sam Chen: closing immediate paging, keeping channel open for updates
Maya Patel: :white_check_mark: thanks team
